name: NV Rendering Formula (Trilerp)
aliases: Volume Ray Tracing with Trilinear Interpolation
definition: Implements an 'NV' rendering formula using trilinear interpolation (trilerp). Includes forward, backward, and fused variants.
summary: The NV Rendering Formula is a direct volume ray casting method that resamples data at evenly spaced locations and composites results using trilinear interpolation.
